title: Outbound Sales Adviser
company: Work Lyf Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Work Lyf Group is currently recruiting for experienced Outbound Sales Advisors to join a thriving and fast-paced sales team based in Crewe. With the busy season approaching, we are looking for motivated and target-driven individuals who enjoy building customer relationships and achieving results.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team, offering a competitive salary, uncapped commission, ongoing training, and genuine career development opportunities.

Salary

28,840 per annum + Uncapped Commission

Available Shifts

Monday to Friday (40 Hours)

Monday late shift 08:50am - 19:30pm

Tues,Wed,Thurs 08:50am - 17:20pm

Friday 08:50am - 15:20pm

or

Mon-Thurs 08:50am-19:30pm

The Role

As an Outbound Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for contacting existing and prospective customers, promoting products and services, generating sales opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer service.

Key responsibilities include:
- Making outbound sales calls to existing and potential customers
- Building and maintaining strong customer relationships
- Identifying customer needs and recommending suitable products and services
- Working towards individual and team sales targets
- Managing customer information and call activity through CRM systems
- Scheduling follow-up calls and maintaining an active sales pipeline
- Handling customer enquiries professionally and efficiently
- Participating in ongoing training, coaching, and development sessions
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to achieve team objectives

What We're Looking For

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- A minimum of 6 months' cold calling experience OR 12 months' experience within an outbound sales/contact centre environment
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong customer service skills
- The ability to work towards targets and KPIs
- Good IT skills, including experience using CRM systems
- A positive attitude and strong team-working ethic

Benefits
- Competitive salary of 28,840
- Uncapped commission structure
- Full training and ongoing coaching
- Supportive and friendly team environment
- Career progression opportunities
- Company benefits package

If you're a motivated sales professional looking to join a growing business and maximise your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Outbound Sales Advisor

Knutsford

29391 + Benefits (including 30 days holiday! ) & Bonus

Are you a confident communicator who enjoys helping customers while achieving sales targets? Do you have experience working in a call centre, customer service, telesales, or regulated sales environment?

We're looking for an enthusiastic Outbound Sales Advisor to join a market-leading organisation

Working within a supportive and high-performing team, you'll engage with customers, explain product options clearly and professionally, and help them make informed decisions that meet their needs.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building rapport, delivering exceptional customer service, and working in a role where quality, compliance, and customer outcomes are equally important.

The Role as a Outbound Sales Advisor

As an Outbound Sales Advisor, you'll contact customers who have expressed an interest in our services, guiding them through available options and answering any questions they may have.

You'll combine excellent customer service with consultative selling, ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information while maintaining the highest standards of FCA compliance.

Key Responsibilities
- Contact customers through outbound calls and email communications
- Explain product features, benefits, and suitability in a clear and professional manner
- Deliver outstanding customer service at every stage of the customer journey
- Manage customer enquiries and follow up on leads generated through various channels
- Accurately maintain customer records using CRM and internal systems
- Identify potentially vulnerable customers and follow appropriate processes
- Meet individual and team KPI, quality, and sales targets
- Ensure all conversations and customer interactions remain fully compliant
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the wider department
- Support continuous improvement and adapt to changing business requirements

What We're Looking For
Essential Experience
- Previous experience within an outbound sales, telesales, contact centre
- Strong telephone-based communication skills
- Proven ability to build rapport and influence customers positively
- Experience recording and maintaining accurate customer information
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and CRM systems
- Ability to work to targets, deadlines, and quality standards

Personal Qualities
- Professional, empathetic, and customer-focused approach
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Self-motivated with a positive attitude
- Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
- Flexible team player with strong problem-solving abilities

Working Hours
- 37.5 hours per week
- Monday to Friday working pattern
- Rotational weekend requirement of one day per weekend rota
- Day off in lieu provided during the following week
